_comment: Well-known NYC landmarks force-kept in enrichment. Each entry carries an OSM geometry (geocoded once via OpenStreetMap/Nominatim, NYC-bounded) as WKT plus a [lat, lon] label point. Enrichment attaches a landmark to a listing purely by geometric distance: listing point to landmark geometry (polygon/line EDGE, so a listing across the street from a big park measures ~0m) within LANDMARK_RADIUS. No POI name matching — that caused a same-named POI elsewhere in the city to collapse onto a canonical name (e.g. every listing 'near Central Park'). NYC scope. Curated by hand / geocoded; intended to be LLM-maintained later.
